name: MRS-CI
full_name: Minimum Reporting Set for Cultic Influence on Crime
scope: one sentence per item in the abstract of a study on cultic influence and crime
measurement: title+abstract, twelve lexical detectors, 170 records with an abstract

items.name: Group operational definition
items.minimum_form: the criterion used to classify the group, and its source, in one sentence

items.name: Participant role
items.minimum_form: leader / core executor / ordinary member / victim / former member, with the basis

items.name: Involvement and exit duration
items.minimum_form: month-level start and end, or years; an explicit 'unknown' is acceptable

items.name: Named manipulation mechanism
items.minimum_form: the term actually used, from a checkable list

items.name: Standardised instrument
items.minimum_form: name, score, and administration context; a negative statement also satisfies

items.name: Offence type
items.minimum_form: offence category under a named classification

items.name: Offence severity
items.minimum_form: a statutory grade, a study-internal grade, or a sentence length

items.name: Legal outcome
items.minimum_form: charge, conviction, sentence, responsibility finding or ruling, with the date

items.name: Jurisdiction
items.minimum_form: country and the applicable responsibility framework

items.name: Data source and recruitment
items.minimum_form: clinical / forensic / self-report / media / court file, and how participants entered

recommended_in_addition.name: Comparison or baseline
recommended_in_addition.minimum_form: a comparison group, a baseline, or an explicit 'none'

recommended_in_addition.name: Sample size
recommended_in_addition.minimum_form: n for persons, cases or documents, stated explicitly
